waypoints.name: Cutthroat Creek/Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: On FR-400, 1 mi off SR-20 east of Washington Pass.
waypoints.directions: Turn off SR-20 onto Forest Road 400 about 4 miles east of Washington Pass and follow it roughly a mile to the Cutthroat Lake Trailhead, at about 4,500 ft. Park there and start at the trailhead kiosk on the maintained Cutthroat Creek Trail #483. Don't confuse this with the Cutthroat Peak approach, which leaves an unmarked highway pullout about 1.5 miles west of Washington Pass and has no maintained trail.

waypoints.name: Cutthroat Wall Base
waypoints.note: Base of the granite buttress; descent/rappel gully navigation is the key crux of the day.
